constraints.ocl:
context Rental
inv: self.isCompleted implies self.payment <> null

context Reservation
inv: self.isConfirmed implies self.vehicle <> null

context Branch
inv: (self.reservations->any(x | x.estimatedCost <= 50) <> null) and (self.isOpen = true)

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->one(x | x.doors >= 0)) and (self.staffCount mod 2 = 0)

context Customer
inv: (self.rentals->collect(x | x.lateFee)->notEmpty()) and (self.age mod 2 = 0)

context Reservation
inv: (self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.isConfirmed <> null)

context Rental
inv: (self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.isCompleted implies self.payment <> null)

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->collect(x | x.rentals)->size() >= 1) and (self.vehicleCount mod 2 = 0)

context Customer
inv: self.rentalCount >= 14 and self.rentalCount <= 23

context Branch
inv: self.rentals->size() >= 1 and self.rentals->size() <= 3

context Customer
inv: (if self.depositAmount < self.balance then self.depositAmount else self.balance endif >= 26) and (self.age mod 2 = 0)

context Customer
inv: self.depositAmount >= 31 and self.depositAmount <= 67

context Company
inv: self.branches->size() >= 2 and self.branches->size() <= 3

context Branch
inv: self.capacity <= self.vehicleCount and self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount

context Payment
inv: self.amount <= self.tax and self.tax <= self.discount

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null and self.amount <> null

context Payment
inv: self.amount <> null implies self.tax <> null

context Rental
inv: self.fuelCharge <> null implies self.depositPaid <> null

context Rental
inv: self.depositPaid <> null implies self.fuelCharge <> null

context Customer
inv: (self.reservations->one(x | x.estimatedCost > 1)) and (self.isPremium = true)

context Company
inv: (self.branches->any(x | x.vehicleCount >= 0) <> null) and (self.branches->collect(x | x.staffCount)->notEmpty())

context Payment
inv: self.discount >= 51 and self.discount <= 97
